purpose: Exploratory comparison of creation pipelines, not a model parity claim
cascade: First attempt Nemotron; validation or eligible provider failure retries use GLM; transport/quota indeterminate and billing stop guards unchanged. GLM receives original request and diagnostics, never Nemotron speculative fixes.
validation: Unchanged strict AppSpec parser and existing scenario assertions; transfer cases use new request-fidelity assertions; no fixture/template substitution
reporting: Model-only control and pipeline results separate. Preserve raw provider responses, deterministic derived outputs, usage from every attempt, request hashes and source snapshot.
stopping: Run each planned pilot once. No after-the-fact tuning or winner promotion; report failures and missing usage. No application default changes, deployment or paid route fallback.
